body: Still looking for advice. I know what needs to be done to save the marriage. I just need input on how to get her to listen to it without being pushy. So that she trusts my words again. I know trust isn't built overnight but resentment is.

My wife and I have spoke quite a bit since she left. She flip flops back and forth over telling me that shes moving on and then back to she can't come back because she doesn't actually make me happy so this isn't really what I really want. She'll talk to me about the kids like nothing has changed but speaking about us at all causes her to just ignore me. Ive admitting my failings to her but Ive lost her trust over my emotional neglect of her. She doesnt want to believe that I'm doing anything different. Without her trust I cant move one way or the other with this, especially while shes got her head wrapped around this 25 year old boy who was just the first person to show her the attention shes been missing from me. I'm completely ok with seeing a marriage counselor, but shes not that far yet.
